definitions.gloss: deposit interest rate; rate paid on savings
definitions.explanation: The rate of interest a bank pays on money held in deposit accounts, expressed as an annual percentage. A standard term in personal finance and banking.

examples.japanese: {預金利率|よきんりりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: for the deposit interest rate to fall.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{預金利率|よきんりりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This bank offers a high deposit interest rate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧{低金利|ていきんり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{預金利率|よきんりりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧。
examples.english: After a long stretch of low interest rates, the deposit rate is almost zero.

notes:
The rate earned by the depositor; set low in Japan during long periods of low interest rates.

- {預金利率|よきんりりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧: to raise the deposit rate
- {預金利率|よきんりりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to compare deposit rates
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{預金利率|よきんりりつ}: a high deposit rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧: interest rate — the broad term, covering both deposits and loans
- ⟦{貸出金利|かしだしきんり}→貸出金利：30117_kashidashikinri⟧: lending rate — the rate a bank charges on loans, not pays on deposits
